summary: New shared-password auth verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass on /app/backend/tests/test_auth.py — POST /api/login returns 200 with JWT for 'valutazioni2026' and 401 for wrong password; all data endpoints (GET /api/search, /api/product, /api/history, DELETE /api/history) require Bearer token (401 without, 200 with); POST /api/change-password bumps password_version so pre-change tokens receive 401 (revocation), login with old password then returns 401 and login with new one returns 200; wrong current password → 403, new password <4 chars → 400. Preview password was successfully restored to 'valutazioni2026' at the end of the change-password cycle (final login check 200). Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): cold load shows login-screen (testID present); wrong password renders login-error 'Password errata'; correct password reveals main app (search-input visible); search 'zelda' → results-list with 'Solo giochi'/'Tutti' chips working; add-to-quote-button (7 available after prices load) adds to Preventivo (badge shows 1, VALUTAZIONE € 20,00 on Zelda ToTK); gear icon (open-settings) opens impostazioni-screen with current-password/new-password/confirm-password/save-password/logout-button all present; tapping logout-button returns to login-screen; token persists across page reload (AsyncStorage restore works). Console warnings about deprecated 'shadow*' style props, 'props.pointerEvents', and 'useNativeDriver' missing on web are unchanged from iteration_2 (non-blocking).

issues: Same non-blocking console warnings as iteration_2: shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation and useNativeDriver missing on web.

action_items: None — auth feature works as specified. If parallel pytest-xdist is desired for the full suite, note that TestChangePassword mutates global state (password_version) so it can invalidate other suites' tokens; run test_auth.py serially (as we do: '-o addopts=""'), or gate it with a marker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py require_auth correctly cross-checks JWT 'pv' claim against db.auth_config.password_version — clean revocation on password change (line 162-164).
server.py change-password uses $inc on password_version and $set on password_hash atomically (line 185-188) — good.
server.py seeds the password singleton only when missing (line 58-66) — idempotent, won't clobber a changed password on restart.
api.ts req() calls onUnauthorized() on any 401 and throws a translated message — pairs well with AuthProvider's setOnUnauthorized(signOut) for automatic session-expiry recovery (auth.tsx:27).
AuthGate returns null while ready=false to avoid a login-screen flash before AsyncStorage rehydration (AuthGate.tsx:18) — nice UX detail.
impostazioni.tsx signOut is triggered 1.2s after successful change so the user sees the confirmation message before being kicked back to login (line 30-31) — good.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec but the app uses Bearer tokens (not cookies) so it works; consider tightening origins for the VPS deploy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, wrong-password error, main app reveal, search+chips+add-to-quote, settings open, logout, session persistence)

seed_data_creation: None. Auth password is auto-seeded by server lifespan on empty db (idempotent).
